scenes.narration: The iPhone isn't where Apple makes its best profit. So what is?
In fiscal 2025, Apple sold 416 billion dollars of products and services. The iPhone alone brought in about 210 billion.
After the cost of making them, products keep about 37 cents per dollar. Services, like the App Store and iCloud, keep about 75.
That is about 82 billion dollars of gross profit from Services alone.
Phones get you in the door. Services keep paying.
